subject.en: A gentle Kanto Meowth portrait with a golden forehead coin
subject.zh: 乖巧歪头的关都喵喵，额头留着标志性的金币

moment: The familiar Meowth tips its head attentively toward the viewer and gathers a small front paw close, a quiet affectionate pause in a portrait viewfinder.
interest: The canonical golden forehead coin and expressive paw gesture carry the character identity; the owner-directed character series does not require an added rainbow animal accessory.
paletteDirection: Canonical warm cream, soft camel-brown, dark ear tips and golden coin; gentle continuous matte shading replaces fragmented polygons.
